name: gmp-sop
description: Drafts inspection-ready GMP standard operating procedures for regulated manufacturing. Covers document control, role accountability, process controls, deviation/CAPA handling, and records management aligned to FDA CGMP (21 CFR 210/211), Part 11, ICH Q7/Q9/Q10, WHO GMP, PIC/S, and EU GMP. Use when creating or overhauling a GMP SOP, preparing for audits or inspections, or building compliance-ready procedures. Trigger: GMP, SOP, CGMP, 21 CFR 210, 21 CFR 211, Part 11, ICH Q7, ICH Q9, ICH Q10, WHO GMP, PIC/S, EU GMP.
